content: InstancedMesh frustum culling uses ONE geometry boundingSphere for all instances; instance matrices in world space make the auto-computed sphere wrong (sits at origin, tiny) so meshes vanish at some camera angles. Fixes: set frustumCulled=false for small counts, or maintain a manual boundingSphere covering the wander volume (as this repo's grass already does per island). computeBoundingSphere() per frame for moving instances is wasted CPU for small counts.
